“bad” list: overly fancy environments, overly fancier effects (particles, fog, etc), many 3D based elements, quick/busy gameplay elements vulnerable to lag or slowness

“okay” list: flat 2D boardgame style map/gameplay. Interaction by text boxes, not flashier effects for actions (AKA “an event has happened! -landmarks like cities could have stats, populations, etc effected and controlled by differing factions

-units would be able to have an effect radius on nearby cities and other units

-time had a forward button set, which fast forwarded the world when pressed

-model was time accurate to the sun passing over a landmark on the map, at a good consistent schedule.
